name: Chamber of Persistence
promptTemplate: A side-perspective Victorian zoetrope spinning with {{drum_speed}} speed, featuring a glowing {{figure}} in the interior chamber illuminated by {{palette_style}} tones, with {{slit_count}} optical slits, operating in {{strobe_sync}} mode with {{phosphor_glow}} persistence.

figure.hint: Select the luminous silhouette trapped inside

palette_style.hint: Shift lantern glass hue and rim lighting

strobe_sync.hint: Lock motion, drift freely, or flash with audio

drum_speed.hint: Dial up the revolutions to lock the illusion

slit_count.hint: Changes the shutter frequency and aperture slots

phosphor_glow.hint: Leave persistence trails on the dark backdrop

listing.blurb: A slotted Victorian zoetrope spins on the wall, bringing galloping silhouettes and leaping figures to life through optical strobe persistence.
listing.prompt: A spinning zoetrope seen from the side: through its slits a figure -- a galloping horse of light, a leaping dancer -- comes alive in a strobing loop, the drum's slats blurring past, the motion snapping into focus as the drum reaches speed. Make it striking on a big projected wall in a dark room: a bold composition, rich colour against real blacks, depth, glow, and motion that reads from across the room. Keep a demoscener's economy: lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, low-resolution offscreen buffers for any per-pixel work, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
